notes.title: DangerTrail Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
With this new update, we've added a variety of improvements and new features to enhance your gameplay.

What's new?

Fixes


 We've adjusted the thrust of the turbines in the wind trap.
 Module 4's trap now rotates correctly.
 We've optimized movement in local play mode for a smoother and more responsive experience.
 Improved visual effects at the start of the game.


New Features


 Spectator mode: Now you can watch your friends or other players in action without participating directly in the game!
 Mid-game joining: Join your friends at any point in the game, the fun never ends!
 Customize your game: Choose the number of traps you want to face for a more personalized experience.


UI Improvements


 The chat is now easier to use, with a more intuitive design and better text visibility.
 The pause menu and lobby connection process have been optimized for a smoother experience.
 We've improved the scoring system for greater clarity and accuracy.


More control, more options, more fun!

With this new update, Danger Trail offers you a higher level of customization and control over your gameplay experience. Explore new strategies, challenge your friends!

Thank you for playing Danger Trail!
We continue to work hard to improve the game and offer you the best possible experience. Feel free to share your comments and suggestions with us!

notes.title: DangerTrail Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
With this new update, we've added a series of improvements and new traps that will test your skills and reflexes.

What's new?

Fixes


 We've restored the lighting of the traps. Now an indicator is correctly shown that the trap is activatable.
 The scene torches now have moving particles.
 The movement of remote players has been optimized for a smoother experience.


UI Improvements


 You will now see notifications when a player disconnects, dies, or completes the course.
 We've added a keybind system for the crouch action.
 Start competing! We're implementing an in-game scoring system so you can show off your skill and beat your friends.


New Deadly Traps


 Feel the heat! We've added flamethrowers that will make you run for your life.
 Beware of the rays! The plasma cannon is a new threat you'll have to dodge.
 Get through rotating obstacles! The rotating spikes will test your agility.
 Don't get too close! The side fans will push you towards the traps if you're not careful.


More heat, more action, more fun!

With this new update, Danger Trail becomes even more challenging and exciting. Get ready to face new threats and level up in our new scoring system!

Thank you for playing Danger Trail!
We continue to work hard to improve the game and offer you the best possible experience. Feel free to share your comments and suggestions with us!

notes.title: DangerTrail Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Danger Trail just got even more thrilling with our latest update 0.1.2! This update brings a host of new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.

What's new?

Improved UI
We've polished the user interface for a more intuitive and enjoyable experience.
Sound on! Immerse yourself fully in the world of Danger Trail with the new implementation of in-game sound effects, menus, and lobbies.

More varied map generation
Our map generator has been enhanced to create even more challenging and unique levels.
Enhanced textures: We've fixed some texture issues in the "Dungeon" map, providing a richer visual experience.

More realistic deaths
With the implementation of ragdolls, your characters will now have more detailed and realistic death animations.

More precise movement
We've removed momentum, meaning your character will stop instantly when you release the movement button.

Customize your look
Choose from a variety of skins to personalize your character! And that's just the beginning, with many more skins on the way!

Crouch and escape
The new crouch feature allows you to hide from traps and gain an advantage over the trapper.

The trapper is faster
Beware! The trapper is now more agile and will be harder to escape.

New deadly traps
We've added new traps and variations, as well as color indicators to help you identify the status of each trap.

Ready for new challenges?

With these exciting new features, Danger Trail 0.1.2 will offer you an even more intense and addictive gameplay experience. Don't miss this update and get ready to put your skills to the test!

Thank you for playing Danger Trail!

We're continuously working hard to improve the game and provide you with the best possible experience. Feel free to share your feedback and suggestions with us!

notes.title: DangerTrail Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the first update for Danger Trail is now live! 
Thanks to your valuable feedback and bug reports, we've been hard at work improving your gameplay experience.

What's new in this update?

Performance improvements
We've optimized the network code to reduce latency and improve synchronization between players, especially on lower-speed connections. 
Additionally, we've adjusted the height checking for a smoother and more responsive feel.

Bug fixes
We've squashed several issues that were affecting gameplay, such as camera collisions with environment objects.

Improved user interface
The in-game objective interface has been redesigned for a clearer and more intuitive experience.

Menu Sounds
We have added sounds in the menus to have a response to the actions that are performed

New alert
We've added an alert that will notify you if there aren't enough players to start a match.

Increased freedom of movement
You can now move the camera vertically with your mouse!

Procedural map
The map is now procedurally generated making each game unique.

Thank you for your support!
We want to thank our entire community for your support and for reporting the bugs you've found. 
Your help is invaluable to us and allows us to continuously improve the game.

We're still hard at work to make Danger Trail an even more exciting experience!

Don't miss out on future updates!
